newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 119-day T-bill yields average 33.70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 119-day T-bill yields average 33.70 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an additional tranche of 119-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22073) was 33.70 at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
The earlier tranche of the bills closed on Tuesday at 89.85 to yield 34.36 percent.
Dealers had forecast the yield would be 33.52 to 35.72 percent for the new issue of bills.

Earlier on Wednesday, the Finance Ministry raised 4.48 trillion roubles from an auction of six trillion roubles of 364-day Treasury bills, bringing total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.32 trillion roubles.
The Finance Ministry also paid 381.39 billion roubles in interest on the 18-month series 24005 OFZ interest-bearing government bond maturing July 1997.
It repaid 6.29 trillion roubles in the series 22048 T-bills which matured on Wednesday.
